note: Authored synthetic taxonomy for the SFT training slice. Category identity is the stable 'id'; semantic coverage is keyed to authored intents, never to the display 'name', so a renamed taxonomy still resolves identically. 'roles', 'authoring_notes' and any 'covers'/'definition_intents' map are authoring-only and are stripped by public_projection before any model-facing render.

action_request.description: The sender asks the owner to do something or reply.

receipt_confirmation.description: Confirms that a purchase, order or payment completed.

billing_due.description: A bill, invoice or amount is owed, including overdue reminders.

newsletter_bulk.description: Bulk marketing, an offer, or a newsletter subscription.

personal_note.description: A personal note from someone the owner knows.

security_alert.description: An account or login security notification.

misc_note.description: An authored purpose that no category covers (taxonomy gap probe).
